findings.text: the done-when requires "the number of source rows imported per source" but never compares that number with the rows the stored documents hold, and "a second import adds none" holds for any stable count, so an import that landed 300 of the spreadsheet's 382 rows would satisfy every stated check.

findings.reason: the done-when has no measurable quantity for two of its three imported deliverables, so its single verdict does not cover them.
findings.text: §4 delivers three kinds of imported record — signal-list rows, functional-specification references from six PDFs, and function-category records — yet the done-when counts only "source rows", a quantity undefined for a PDF, and no figure or negative control covers the specification references or the category records, so the section could land with neither present.
